2124557864442474767.en_summary: $SPX has retraced 61.8% of the March to October rally, down 8.6% this week, the biggest down week since the 9.1% week that preceded the 2025 crash low. Friday's low was probably a 16 week cycle low though a lower low next week is still possible.
